role: fresh validation of frozen TPS; excluded from fitting and model selection

Two checks in Craignish and two in northern Hawkesbury; middle Troy evidence remains diagnostic F02.
G02 shares F01 creek; G03 shares C04/F03 brook; G04 shares C05/F04 catchment. None of those referenced checks is fitted. Fresh positions are not independent catchment samples.
No validation of full mainland, eastern mountains, southern town or adjacent-sheet seam.
rejections: Original G01 proposal (4434,1500) was not a creek mouth; geological leader nearby; rejected before scoring.
Troy southern bridge: modern pond/channel and highway position make exact historical crossing uncertain; rejected before scoring.
Northern Hawkesbury next eastern tributary: historic stream ends rather than clearly continuing into matching junction; rejected.
